meta.title: da Lola — Restaurant & Pizzeria in Fermignano
meta.description: A traditional restaurant-pizzeria serving the cuisine of Le Marche in Fermignano: homemade pasta, char-grilled meat and wood-fired pizza in a simple, family atmosphere.

hero.subtitle: The cuisine of Le Marche — homemade pasta and char-grilled meat, with a generous choice of wood-fired pizzas.

intro.title: A true local restaurant & pizzeria
intro.body: At da Lola you can enjoy the traditional dishes of Le Marche in a simple, family atmosphere. All our pasta is made in house and our meat is cooked over the coals. Alongside them you'll find our char-grilled specialities and a generous choice of pizzas baked in the wood-fired oven.

specialties.title: Our specialities
specialties.subtitle: Three things done properly, every day.

items.name: Homemade pasta
items.desc: Tagliatelle, ravioli and the first courses of the Marche tradition, rolled by hand each day — from slow ragù to seasonal truffle.

items.name: Char-grilled meat
items.desc: Steaks and grilled specialities cooked over live coals, from the Fiorentina to the cuts of the day.

items.name: Wood-fired pizza
items.desc: A generous choice of pizzas baked in the wood-fired oven, from a carefully raised dough to a crisp, airy crust.

gallery.title: From our kitchen
gallery.subtitle: A taste of what you'll find on the table.

about.title: A place for grown-ups and children alike
about.body: The bowls green next door and the playground just outside the restaurant make for great fun for grown-ups and children alike, at both lunch and dinner. A simple, family atmosphere where you can take your time between one dish and the next.

people.title: The people behind da Lola
people.body: Behind every plate is a team that rolls the pasta by hand each morning and keeps the coals alive until late. da Lola isn't just a sign over the door — it's our kitchen, opened to you the way you'd welcome someone home.
people.caption: In the kitchen, between dough and embers.
